evals.name: capture-mid-task
evals.prompt: quick note before I forget -- we should eventually add a keyboard shortcut to step the timeline frame-by-frame instead of only dragging the scrubber. save that for later, don't want to lose the thread on what I'm doing right now
evals.expected_output: Creates backlog/ (Backlogs.md + DONE.md) if missing, adds one Inbox row + a task file capturing the idea, asks no clarifying questions, replies with a short one-line confirmation.

evals.name: gate-refuses-unrefined
evals.prompt: let's start on the next backlog item
evals.expected_output: The only backlog item is an unrefined Inbox entry with no priority. The assistant must NOT start implementation work on it -- it should say it hasn't been scoped yet and offer to brainstorm/refine it first.

evals.name: counts-and-refine
evals.prompt: how many tasks do we have pending right now? also let's flesh out the safari scrub investigation one, I have more context on it now
evals.expected_output: Reports counts broken down by status (2 inbox, 1 ready, 0 in-progress), not a single number, and does not count the done item. For the refinement request, it asks clarifying questions about scope/acceptance criteria rather than inventing them.
